scope: Four prior remote-endpoint tests, approved as shown before any production change. test_definitions: the five origins that become valid (plain HTTP, an IPv4 address, a bracketed IPv6 address, a non-default port and a single-label name) leave the refusal list, and the test is renamed test_non_canonical_origins_are_refused. test_reader: its invalid origin becomes ftp://private-host.example, since http:// is now valid. test_plugin: register_models returns the declared model entry instead of an empty list. test_app_regressions: the configured app's provider listing is compared with the bundled app's on the bundled providers' rows only, since a granted account now also sees its endpoints. Nothing else changes.
reason: Hosted BYOM Unit 1 (owner decisions of 2026-10-22): approved HTTP, IP and port origins, a catalog filtered by the account grants, the shared chat cache and a reused client per endpoint. Each edit follows from a contract the owner changed on purpose.
